Setup: Android Emulator named or custom profile; Chrome DevTools slow 3G/4G. Record exact emulator version, control surface, rates and latency.
Customer action: Open a critical list and save one record
Expected local behaviour: Previously stored data renders; the new record commits locally
Expected server behaviour: Sync may wait; server state changes only after acknowledgement
Customer-visible status: Saved on this device, then Waiting to sync
Pass condition: No spinner blocks local work; no false server-confirmed state
Evidence to capture: Screen recording, request timings, local row and sync history
Device and network notes: Record emulator version/control surface and exact profile, or real SIM, operator, broad location type, device and OS

Setup: Select Offline in DevTools or disable cellular data
Customer action: Complete and save an allowed offline operation
Expected local behaviour: Record and outbox item persist across navigation
Expected server behaviour: No server change until connectivity returns
Customer-visible status: Saved on this device; Waiting to sync
Pass condition: Reopen app and find the exact record still pending
Evidence to capture: Local database row, outbox row, screen recording
Device and network notes: Use a test account and synthetic record

Scenario: Connection drops during save or upload
Setup: Start a save or attachment upload, then disable data mid-request
Customer action: Wait, reconnect and retry if required
Expected local behaviour: Original record/file remains available; upload state is retained
Expected server behaviour: One final server record; no duplicate effect
Pass condition: No data loss and no duplicate business record
Evidence to capture: Request log, outbox state, final record count, file hash
Device and network notes: Record upload size and whether resume is supported

Setup: Save while offline; background, force-stop and reopen the app
Expected server behaviour: Sync resumes on a supported trigger
Pass condition: No in-memory-only work; no duplicate after restart
Evidence to capture: Before/after local DB snapshot, lifecycle log, sync history
Device and network notes: Test actual target Android version and device class

Setup: Keep network connected while blocking the API host or using a captive portal
Customer action: Save or refresh a critical record
Expected local behaviour: Local work remains durable; remote read/write failure is explicit
Expected server behaviour: No server update until API is reachable
Customer-visible status: Connection available; service not reachable; pending
Pass condition: Network indicator never implies the record is synced
Evidence to capture: Network log, API error, UI state, outbox
Device and network notes: Record whether DNS, TLS, captive portal or API caused failure

Setup: Save an allowed operation offline, expire the session, then reconnect
Expected server behaviour: Protected operation waits for valid authentication
Customer-visible status: Sign in to sync; work remains saved locally
Pass condition: No data loss and no infinite retry of invalid credentials
Evidence to capture: Auth response, pending operation, re-auth flow and audit log

Scenario: Duplicate tap or timeout after server receipt
Setup: Simulate timeout after server acceptance; retry or tap Save again
Expected local behaviour: Client retains the same operation/idempotency key
Customer-visible status: Checking status or Synced; never two records
Pass condition: Retry is idempotent and the original operation is resolved
Evidence to capture: Operation ID, server reference, DB count and event log
Device and network notes: Test timeout after commit, not only before request arrival

Setup: Edit the same record on two offline devices; reconnect in different orders
Expected local behaviour: Both edits remain inspectable until the rule resolves them
Expected server behaviour: Documented merge, rejection or human-resolution rule applies
Customer-visible status: Conflict needs review when automatic resolution is unsafe
Pass condition: No silent overwrite; audit trail shows both edits
Evidence to capture: Both local versions, server version, conflict event and resolution
Device and network notes: Record device clocks and sync order

Scenario: Local storage full or write failure
Setup: Fill test storage or force a local database write error
Expected local behaviour: No success state unless local commit succeeds; recoverable draft where possible
Customer-visible status: Could not save; free space or retry
Evidence to capture: Storage/write error, UI state and persisted data check
Device and network notes: Use synthetic data; do not fill a production device

Setup: Switch Wi-Fi to mobile data during a read, save or sync
Expected local behaviour: Local state and operation ID remain stable
Expected server behaviour: Retry safely against the same operation
Pass condition: No duplicate or lost operation across handoff
Evidence to capture: Network log, operation ID, final server record
Device and network notes: Repeat on networks used by the target customers

Setup: Use a metered/mobile profile and low-battery test state
Customer action: Complete a small critical task and queue a large attachment
Expected server behaviour: Large optional sync follows the product's stated data/battery policy
Customer-visible status: Critical work saved; large sync deferred if policy requires
Pass condition: No unexpected large transfer; user can see deferred work
Evidence to capture: Bytes transferred, battery state, queue and policy log
Device and network notes: Policy is product-specific; do not assume Wi-Fi-only is right for every user

Setup: Use target device classes, actual SIM/operators and representative indoor/outdoor locations
Customer action: Complete one end-to-end critical workflow under observed conditions
Expected local behaviour: Local save and recovery behave as promised
Expected server behaviour: Sync converges or raises an explicit conflict
Pass condition: All release gates pass on the real customer workflow
Evidence to capture: Screen recording, app version, device/OS, operator, location type, timestamps and issue log
Device and network notes: Repeat for each operator/market the product explicitly supports
